name: ATM Inquiry Response V 03
definition: The ATMInquiryResponse message is sent by an ATM manager or its agent to the ATM to provide the information and the outcome of the verifications requested in the ATMInquiryRequest.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMInquiryResponse.name: ATM Inquiry Response
ATMInquiryResponse.definition: Information related to the response of an ATM inquiry from an ATM manager.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC.
